**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Auto-paste
- **Works in WhisperShortcut's own Chat.** Dictating into the Chat input now pastes the text there, like in any other app. It pastes only when the same text field still has focus; the recording pill, popups and Settings keep the text on the clipboard.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.52...v8.53
